verdict.score_rationale: The board lands at the 6–6.5 anchor because its spacious, clearly sectioned layout is readable with effort, but very small text and several long dashed exception routes prevent comfortable arm’s-length reading.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: There is abundant open space around most nodes, but many labels and chips are extremely small at the full-board scale, and the “parallel” chip crowds the Section 6 header.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Large outlined and lightly tinted regions with numbered headers make the main stages and auxiliary workflows identifiable without tracing edges.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: The solid serving path is mostly clean, but the red dashed exception paths make long multi-turn detours across section boundaries, forcing backtracking and competing with nearby labels.

sub_checks.name: density_and_decomposition
sub_checks.note: Ink density is low and most sections contain only two to four nodes, so decomposition is strong, though the oversized canvas makes the content and typography visually underscaled.
